title: Rick Doty sent to collect the witnesses' medical records
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base flight surgeon's office, South Dakota

tellings.quote: he was brought in to go over sent over to the flight surgeon's office to pick up our medical records

plain: In 1977, after a missile security team at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota said they had a strange encounter, a man named Rick Doty was sent to the base flight surgeon's office to pick up the team members' medical records. A former Air Force security guard named Mario Woods, one of that team, says so, passing on what he was later told, and also names a fellow team member, Michael Johnson. Woods raises it because it suggests someone was quietly gathering information on the men afterwards.
